timing.source: declared demonstration tempo; not measured from source photographs

isolation_range.method: Declared standing isolation technique, measured from actual body and arm joints at every frame; separate photo comparisons retain uncertainty and source conflicts.

isolation_profile.method: declared upright isolation technique; source depth is not calibrated

head_body_clearance.method: finite convex weight-head/body surface samples; hand contact checked separately

Standing isolation exercises keep an upright torso.
Both knees remain upright rather than holding a crouch.
Both hips remain extended in the standing posture.
The body stays stable while the arms move.
Both arms move together.
The upper arms stay beside the torso while the elbows bend.
The upper arms remain close to the body.
The curl starts with both elbows extended.
Both elbows complete the curl.
The elbows do not fold beyond the declared curl range.
Feet must reach the floor.
